description: The plot illustrates how loss ratio (in percent) varies with compute measured in TFLOPs for several SepLLM configurations. The x-axis is labeled “TFLOPs,” uses a logarithmic scale, and spans from 1e7 to 9e8 with tick labels at 1e7, 2e7, 5e7, 1e8, 2e8, 3e8, 4e8, 5e8, 6e8, 7e8, 8e8, and 9e8. The y-axis is labeled “Loss Ratio (%)” on a linear scale, ranging from 94 to 100 with integer tick intervals. A purple line with triangle markers (solid) stays flat at 100% across all TFLOPs. An orange solid line with plus markers labeled “SepLLM (n=64)” starts near 98.3% at 1e7, rises to about 100.0% by 2e8, reaches about 100.4% at 4e8, and ends around 99.9% at 9e8 with small fluctuations near 100% after 2e8. A blue solid line with x markers labeled “SepLLM (n=128)” begins around 97.0% at 1e7, increases to about 99.9% by 4e8–5e8, then slightly dips and oscillates just under 100%, ending near 99.8% at 9e8. A green solid line with diamond markers labeled “SepLLM (n=64, H)” starts around 97.5% at 1e7, climbs to about 100.0% by 4e8–5e8, peaks slightly above 100% around 6e8 (about 100.2%), and finishes near 99.9% at 9e8. A red solid line with circle markers labeled “SepLLM (n=64, H/T)” starts at about 94.0% at 1e7, rises to roughly 99.1% by 4e8, dips to about 98.5% at 5e8, returns to about 99.0% at 6e8–7e8, and ends around 98.7% at 9e8.
